name: marqly
description: Search, read and organize your Marqly bookmarks, boards, tags and highlights from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Marqly is a bookmark manager for the links, articles, videos and highlights you save across the web. This plugin connects your Marqly library to ChatGPT so you can find and use what you have already saved without leaving the conversation.

Ask ChatGPT to find bookmarks by topic, tag, board or site; open a saved page and work with its full text; list your boards, tags and highlights; spot duplicates and broken links; or look up how a Marqly feature works in the help center.

When you allow changes for the connection, ChatGPT can also save new links, file them into boards, rename or merge tags and boards, and add highlights. Every change made through the plugin is recorded in Marqly with a 30-day undo under Settings, AI Assistant, Activity.

The plugin only reads and changes the library of the Marqly account you sign in with. Read access and write access are separate permissions you approve when you connect, and you can revoke the connection at any time from Marqly.
capabilities: Search your saved bookmarks by topic, tag, board or site
Read the full text of a saved page
List your boards, tags and highlights
Find duplicate bookmarks and broken links
Save links and organize boards and tags (with your permission)
Answer how-to questions from the Marqly help center
defaultPrompt: Find what I saved about design inspiration
Summarize the bookmarks in one of my boards
Which of my saved links are broken?

positive.prompt: Which boards do I have in Marqly?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's boards with their bookmark counts, including NEDC, ICN Security, Online learning, Cloud storage and VPN. Does not invent boards.

positive.description: Show the contents of one board
positive.prompt: Show me the bookmarks in my VPN board.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the bookmarks filed in the VPN board (about 12) with their titles and links. Only bookmarks from that board are listed.

positive.prompt: Find my saved bookmarks about cloud storage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching bookmarks from the demo library, led by the ones in the Cloud storage board, each with its title and link.

positive.prompt: Which of my bookmarks are tagged design?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the bookmarks tagged design in the demo account (4) with titles and links, and nothing tagged otherwise.

positive.description: Answer a product how-to from the help center
positive.prompt: How do I import my Chrome bookmarks into Marqly?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the import steps from the Marqly help center and links to the help article. Does not touch the user's library.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the user's saved links
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Sending messages is not something the plugin does
negative.prompt: Email these links to my team.

negative.description: Open web search, not a search of the user's own library
negative.prompt: Search the web for this week's best VPN reviews.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything, show plans or prices, or link to checkout. It only reads and organizes the user's own Marqly library.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read and organize your Marqly bookmarks, boards, tags and highlights from ChatGPT, with help center answers. Changes made through the plugin can be undone in Marqly for 30 days.
